title: Episode
description: Stage 2+ artifact: the assembled benchmark unit for one video, binding its media, metadata, procedure, timeline and errors. Stage 1 defines the field specification only.

path.description: Path to the video file, relative to the dataset root.

procedure_path.description: Path to the procedure JSON, relative to the dataset root; null until Stage 2.

timeline_path.description: Path to the timeline JSON, relative to the dataset root; null until Stage 2.

error_paths.description: Paths to error JSONs, relative to the dataset root; empty until Stage 2.

metadata_path.description: Path to the Stage 1 video metadata JSON, relative to the dataset root.

stage.description: Pipeline stage that produced this episode, e.g. 'stage2'.
